name.value: Cut Salt Block with Grade Figure

endonym.gloss: a gloss of the four-beat figure incised on the face

description.value: A half-metre block of pan salt carrying an incised four-beat figure on one face, the name of the grade that cut it, put on at the trench and not afterwards. Blocks are cut on a grid, dried on the crust for a season and hauled out, and the figure identifies the cutting grade for as long as the block exists, which is not long, since a block is eventually eaten. Incision is done with the striking knob and reads as a name to anybody who has heard it struck, a claim the survey tested against recordings and found to hold. This block was withheld from a haul and given to the 2281 team dry.
